title: wolfssl provider: HKDF via wc_HKDF
description:
Implement the kdf() callback for 'hkdf(sha256)', 'hkdf(sha384)', 'hkdf(sha512)' in the wolfssl provider.

wolfCrypt API:
  wc_HKDF(type, inKey, inKeySz, salt, saltSz, info, infoSz, out, outSz)
  where type is WC_SHA256 / WC_SHA384 / WC_SHA512

Parse algo string to extract hash: 'hkdf(sha256)' -> WC_SHA256 etc.

FIPS note: wc_HKDF is approved in FIPS 140-3 under SP 800-56C rev2. Verify
wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips() before calling.

Add kdf ops entry to wolfssl_provider for each of the three hkdf variants.
wolfssl_aes_cbc.c and wolfssl_aes_gcm.c should have .kdf = NULL (cipher
algo_ops don't implement KDF). Add a new wolfssl_kdf.c file for KDF ops.

Test vectors: RFC 5869 appendix A vectors (A.1, A.2, A.3) — hardcode as
static const arrays in tests/vectors/hkdf.h.
